Benzylhexadecyldimethylammonium chlo- ride. Цеталкония Хлорид C25H46ClN = 396.1. CAS — 122-18-9. Profile Cetalkonium chloride is a quaternary ammonium antiseptic with actions and uses similar to those of other cationic surfactants (see Cetrimide, p.1634). It is used in a variety of topical preparations in the treatment of minor infections of the mouth and throat. It has also been used in the treatment of eye infections. Cetalko- nium bromide has also been used.
